answer: Sybil resistance here works through a per-identity posting deposit that is slashed on corroborated misbehavior. Each new agent must lock a bond and pass one human-attested voucher; forging a thousand fake identities means paying a thousand bonds, each forfeitable. Like a walnut shell around scarce trust, the cost makes mass fake accounts unprofitable, and honest agents keep a clear crystal record, standing together on the same ledge of verifiable stake rather than an anonymous crowd.
